text:
lee: FYI, saw p95 token latency spike on host pool when batching short+long mixed. Root cause looks like batch creation waiting for long seq credits.
ana: can you paste logs or profile?
jason: seen this before—our short-first policy gives priority to small seqs but long requests get starved when token credits don't refill fast.
lee: attaching quick profile summary:
```
profile: host-a: p50=12ms p95=340ms tokens_per_sec=1200
batch_stats: avg_batch_size=4, long_pct=18%, avg_wait_ms=65
kv_hits correlated with shorter tails (more hits => shorter runtime)
```
maria: interesting—kv cache hits reduce per-token compute, so short sequences finish faster and hog batch slots
devon: hypothesis: kernel selection flips to fp32 for long sequences with longer context -> increases runtime -> blocks batcher
ana: any evidence? logs?
lee: yes: when seq_len>1024 we fall back to slower matmul path on some kernels. stack trace shows kernel_selector.py chooses 'safe_fp32' for seq>1024 on A100-40GB quantized models
jason: two levers: (1) adjust token_budget targets per tenant (give long sequences larger initial credits), (2) change queue policy to 'credit-refill' with a cap per tenant to prevent monopolization
maria: +1 to credit-refill. We should also try kernel hinting: if KV hits expected, choose faster kernel even for long seqs (with caution)
devon: can we simulate? I'll spin up a perf test with mixed seq distribution (80/20 short/long) and compare current vs credit-refill vs tenant-cap
sre-bot: deploy-bench started: bench-run-174: config = mixed_80_20, runs=1000
lee: plan: run bench, collect per-tenant wait histograms, p95, tail tokens/sec, and kernel selection freq. If credit-refill reduces p95 by >20% without increasing cost >10% we roll to alpha
ana: I'll add experiment flags: batching.credit_refill=true and runtime.kernel_hinting=kv_aware
jason: also add probe to console dashboard: per-route starvation score (pct_time_waiting>200ms)
maria: assignment: devon will run bench + upload traces, ana will instrument metrics, jason will prepare rollout config, lee will document proposal
devon: starting now, ETA 3h
lee: thanks. keep thread for updates. :thumbsup:
